root_text:
HMPV can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia.

Bronchitis - Inflammation of the airways in the lungs that is usually causes by an infection. 

Pneumonia - Inflammation and fluids in lungs caused by a bacterial state, viral or fungal infections.
